metadata.name: wagerwake
metadata.description: Escrow, fee and VRF-gated payout program for Dice & Cards

instructions.name: ante_again
docs: Pays the identical stake again for a carry-over round. The platform fee
is not charged again.

instructions.name: claim_void_refund
docs: Claims a seat's own refund from a voided table. Funds can only ever go to
the seat's player, never to the admin.

instructions.name: commit_seed
docs: Publishes sha256(seed) for the current round before any turn is played.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Creates a table and its program-owned USDC escrow (an associated token
account whose authority is the table PDA).

instructions.name: finalize_ante
docs: Permissionless once the 60s ante window closes: non-anted seats forfeit
their share to the pot. One remaining player takes the pot; two or more
continue into the next round with fresh randomness.

instructions.name: forfeit_seat
docs: Timeout/disconnect handling. The server calls this after the 60s turn
timer expires; a forfeiting seat keeps its stake in the pot. If only one
active player remains, the pot resolves immediately.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time configuration. The signer becomes the (multisig) authority.
Player funds can never be withdrawn by this authority.

instructions.name: join_table
docs: Seats a player and moves `stake + fee` USDC into escrow.

instructions.name: leave_table
docs: Full refund while the table is still in the waiting room.

instructions.name: record_vrf
docs: Reveals the seed. The program verifies it against the published
commitment; a mismatch (or any payout without this instruction) reverts.
Devnet builds accept an oracle signature here. Production must add
Switchboard On-Demand account validation in this handler; see docs/vrf.md.

instructions.name: resolve_dice_round
docs: Replays every active player's dice turn from the recorded seed and pays
the pot. No scores are trusted from the caller: only reroll masks.

instructions.name: start_game
docs: Permissionless: starts the game once every seat is ready.

instructions.name: submit_card_result
docs: Zwanzig ab resolution. The card engine currently runs in the realtime
server; the winner is attested by the oracle and bound to the recorded
VRF seed and a published shuffle/log hash. See docs/vrf.md for the
trust model and the roadmap to an on-chain card verifier.

instructions.name: void_table
docs: Emergency valve: only after 30 days stuck in round 1. Moves no funds; it
merely unlocks per-seat refunds. The admin cannot redirect a single cent.

fields.name: authority
docs: Multisig authority (e.g. a Squads vault). Can pause and rotate the oracle
but can never move player funds.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Settlement oracle allowed to publish commitments, reveal seeds and submit
turn records. In devnet this is the game server; on mainnet it should be a
Switchboard-gated crank.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination of collected platform fees (USDC token account owner).

fields.name: fee_per_player
docs: Charged per player, once, when the game starts. Always on top of the stake.

types.name: DiceTurn
docs: A player's dice turn, recorded by the settlement oracle. The turn contains no
scores: only the player's choices (which dice to reroll). The program replays
the dice from the round seed and computes the score itself.

fields.name: reroll_masks
docs: `reroll_masks[i]` has bit d set when die d was rerolled on roll i+2.

fields.name: stake
docs: Stake per player per round, in USDC base units (6 decimals).

fields.name: fee
docs: Snapshot of `config.fee_per_player` at table creation.

fields.name: active
docs: Still competing in the current round (false after a forfeit).

fields.name: anted_round
docs: Round in which this seat paid its ante.

fields.name: pot_stakes
docs: Sum of every stake held for this game (including carried-over rounds).

fields.name: pot_fees
docs: Sum of every player fee held for this game.

fields.name: refunded
docs: Set when a voided table has refunded a seat.
